You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of creators, the payment layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-github-pages-free-12|Everything You]] breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-15. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Sovereign commerce infrastructure works by leveraging open-source tools and decentralized payment systems, ensuring that creators maintain control over their sales and customer data. This approach eliminates the risks associated with platform dependence, such as account suspension or transaction fees. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, creators can establish a reliable and scalable sales pipeline.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign commerce infrastructure, you need to prepare your digital products, such as ebooks, and set up a cryptocurrency wallet to receive payments. You'll also need to choose a hosting platform, select a backend logic tool, and sign up for a NOWPayments account. Additionally, consider investing in the Complete Builder Kit, which provides comprehensive documentation and templates to streamline your deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your hosting platform and backend logic tool. This involves configuring webhooks, setting up payment notifications, and establishing a system for automatic product delivery. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can be used to automate the delivery process, ensuring that customers receive their digital products instantly after payment confirmation.
Deploy your sovereign commerce infrastructure today.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your sales grow, you can scale your infrastructure by upgrading your hosting plan, adding more products, and optimizing your backend logic for improved performance. Consider using Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery to further enhance your infrastructure. With a solid foundation in place, you can focus on marketing and promoting your digital products to reach a wider audience.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Take control of your sales and customer data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The Complete Builder Kit, available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, is a valuable resource for digital creators seeking to establish a robust and independent sales platform. This kit provides the necessary tools and documentation to deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure, empowering creators to take control of their sales and customer data.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: set up your hosting platform, choose a backend logic tool, sign up for a NOWPayments account, integrate NOWPayments with your hosting platform, configure webhooks and payment notifications, establish a system for automatic product delivery, test your payment pipeline, and go live. Consider investing in the Complete Builder Kit to streamline your deployment process and ensure a solid foundation for your sales platform.
